title: Nutty Warm Brussel Sprouts

items.item: fresh breadcrumbs (pulse 1½ slices of bread in the food processor)
brussels sprouts, trimmed and halved (about 8 cups)

instructions: Heat 1 teaspoon of oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add the garlic; cook for 1 minute, just until golden, stirring constantly. Add the breadcrumbs; cook for 1 minute, until lightly browned, stirring constantly. Transfer the garlic mixture to a small bowl.

Separate the leaves from the brussels sprouts; quarter the cored centers. Heat the remaining ½ tsp of oil over medium heat. Add the leaves and cores to the pan; cook for 8 minutes, just until the leaves wilt and the cores are crisp-tender, stirring frequently.
Remove from the heat; toss with the breadcrumb mixture, salt, and pepper. Top with the walnuts.
